status: Static adapter ownership confirmed; SCP finite MMIO budget reviewed; passive existing-request observer selected, implementation pending

semaphore_budget.scope: Static MMIO operation counts excluding diagnostic printk and memory accesses; not a latency or live activity measurement
semaphore_budget.failure_ownership: Last helper write has no subsequent readback; outer loop can acquire on count==0 then report -EBUSY without releasing. Failure does not prove semaphore unowned.

decision.selected: Default-off observation of one already-occurring bound-driver REG06 read, not a new charger request
decision.why: Existing CV config path reads REG06 periodically. Observing it can supply byte/completion/count evidence without adding pointer/read traffic or another semaphore/reset opportunity.
decision.entry: One explicit diagnostic arm, consume before observing first matching driver request, retain one result; no repeat or policy change
decision.identity: Bound I2C0 0x6b driver, expected controller, same request pointer and same controller-owned completion metadata
decision.acceptance: Require exact two-message shape, FIFO/WRRD, completion bit, no ACK/NACK, FIFO count=1 and successful helper result; omit value on failure
decision.pending: Implement minimal driver/controller hook and result ownership; test refusal/error/short-FIFO paths; clean pushed Buildbox compile; candidate/recovery admission

limitations: Metadata reads did not access charger registers, MMIO, power telemetry or primary boot storage
DT flags describe inputs; observer must validate actual controller fields, clock/resource mode and request ownership
No observed semaphore failure or cleanup defect on device
No implementation, build, boot candidate or mainline charger support claim
redactions: Sanitized binding/DT facts, boot ID, hashes and process counts only. Raw capture, source and disassembly remain private.
